Delightful traditional Vietnamese food
Nov 2025 • Couples
Went here on the recommendation of a local guide, as it was just around the corner & served traditional Vietnamese.

It was a Sunday afternoon so it wasn’t particularly busy. It was a quaint rustic setup - open to the street. The first thing the staff pointed up was they only take cash or electronic transfer no credit cards. Which we had already be warned was the case.

The staff don’t speak a lot of English but the menu does have English descriptions. So was fairly easy to confirm our order. We’d been told that the savoury pancakes (Banh Kot Tom) spring rolls (Goi Cuon), and Vietnamese Broken Rice w/rib, pigskin & egg roll (Com Tam Suon Bi Cha) would not disappoint. Our guide was nor wrong. Our food orders came fairly promptly probably because it wasn’t busy. 

This was a nice relaxing meal on our first day in Saigon. Great introduction to Vietnamese cuisine.

A sure value
Apr 2025 • Friends
Excellent experience in this restaurant offering a wide variety of products, and everything was very good.
Special mention to the spring roll and its divine sauce.
But everything was really good: nem bun, vermicelli salad and seafood, nems and finally, fruit salad. Be careful, the fruit mix is served with salt as a side dish in a ramekin, I thought it was red sugar I was particularly surprised:)
Many Vietnamese came to eat, a guarantee of confidence in local techniques and quality, of course.
I would have liked to stay a few more days in Saigon to go back and taste other things.

Big restaurant does cheat on menu
Jun 2023 • Friends
I and my friend came to this restaurant on 20th June at 40B Tran Cao Van, dist 3, HCM City (Near Turtle Lake). We saw menu with the HEADLINE of RICE and we ordered CHICKEN WING + CHICKEN THIGH and some drink. After waiting for 20 mins for meals, we got shock when getting a bill even higher double price compared on menu. 

We asked why the price on menu of chicken wing (45,000 VND), chicken thigh (55,000 VND) but they charged us 200,000 VND instead of 100,000 VND for both meals? 

The waitress said that price on menu NOT INCLUDING OF RICE, But they gave us chicken WITH RICE! HOW RICE is even MORE EXPENSIVE than CHICKEN in VIETNAM ???? this is really a CHEAT!
If this owner of restaurant runs business with moral, they will not play trick on MENU.

If All of you doesn't read every words carefully on menu, you will be trapped. 
How shameful of big restaurant !

The place didn't seem very clean and one thing that shot me down was the fact that they didn't provide any napkins at all, just one fresh towel when you first sit down, I mean, what a big **** up!

Do not come here! There are much better places in this city.
